result.markdown:
# Power Failure and Battery Exhaustion at Site S-TUN-004

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-TUN-004`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm sequence matches battery exhaustion signature; maintenance, transport, and changes were checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-19 17:30 to 2026-09-19 20:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-19 15:43
- **Affected:** S-TUN-004

## Summary

AC mains power was lost at site S-TUN-004, causing the site to run on battery power until exhaustion, resulting in site down and traffic drop.

Traffic and availability dropped on site S-TUN-004 due to power loss.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-19 15:43: Major MAINS_FAILURE alarm raised on S-TUN-004. [ALM-000323]
- 2026-09-19 17:09: Battery inspection maintenance window started on S-TUN-004. [MW-0007]
- 2026-09-19 17:16: Major BATTERY_LOW alarm raised on S-TUN-004. [ALM-000326]
- 2026-09-19 17:30: KPI drop and alert detected on S-TUN-004. [T1, ALR-0020]
- 2026-09-19 17:31: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-004. [ALM-000327]
- 2026-09-19 19:56: MAINS_FAILURE and BATTERY_LOW alarms cleared on S-TUN-004. [ALM-000323, ALM-000326]
- 2026-09-19 20:00: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared and site recovered. [ALM-000327]

## Evidence

- Site S-TUN-004 experienced MAINS_FAILURE at 15:43 followed by BATTERY_LOW at 17:16. [ALM-000323, ALM-000326]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarm occurred at 17:31, matching the KPI onset at 17:30. [ALM-000327, T1]
- No configuration changes were made on S-TUN-004 and its parents between 12:00 and 21:00. [T3]
- A battery inspection maintenance window overlapped the event on S-TUN-004. [MW-0007]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-TUN-004: confirmed. Sequence of MAINS_FAILURE, BATTERY_LOW, and SITE_DOWN perfectly matches power failure runbook signature. [ALM-000323, ALM-000326, ALM-000327, RB-POWER-FAILURE#02]
2. **planned_maintenance** at S-TUN-004: rejected. Runbooks state a MAINS_FAILURE alarm is never part of a planned window, ruling out maintenance as the primary cause. [MW-0007, RB-POWER-FAILURE#03]

## Ruled out

- MW-0007: Battery inspection coincided with the outage, but mains failure cannot be caused by a planned window per runbook rules.
- T3: No changes were found on the site or its parents during the relevant time window.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect site AC mains power supply and feeding lines at S-TUN-004.
- Verify battery backup health and autonomy duration following the inspection.

confounders.why: A window on S-TUN-004 covering the outage in time, but an inspection with no expected impact; the mains failure preceded it.

truth.notes: trap=near_miss_maintenance; Mains failure at S-TUN-004; battery lasted 1.8 h, so KPIs were normal until the batteries were exhausted. The maintenance window on S-TUN-004 covers the time the site was down but announces no impact, and the mains failure began 86 min before it opened. Trap: a maintenance window on S-TUN-004 covers the whole time the site was down, so a hasty investigator calls it planned. Settled by: (1) the window's expected impact says none, so it fails the nature test; (2) MAINS_FAILURE was raised well before the window opened and BATTERY_LOW followed before SITE_DOWN, which is the power sequence, not an inspection.
